student_learning_goal: I can collect data to answer a math question about my community.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can collect data to answer a math question about my community.
header.character_watermark: Coach Cara in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Tally and record data for 4 community situations.
parts.visual_layout: Top of page. Four tally rows with community-scale data.

image_placeholders.description: Four tally rows in B&W, ~7in x 3in. Pre-filled situations: 'Rink visitors: 50', 'Library books: 250', 'Pizzas sold: 80', 'TTC riders: 350'. Header 'Community Tally:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P1_TALLY: keywords (community, tally) name the rows.

parts.student_instructions: Use your data to answer 3 questions.
parts.visual_layout: Middle of page. Three numbered slots.

image_placeholders.description: Three slots in B&W, ~7in x 2.5in. Q1 'TOTAL?'. Q2 'BIGGEST?'. Q3 'SMALLEST?'. Header 'Use Your Data:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P2_USE: keywords (data) name the slots.

parts.student_instructions: Pick something to count in your community. Tally. Write 1 question.

image_placeholders.description: A blank box in B&W, ~7in x 2.5in. Tally area + question line. Header 'My Real Community Data:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P3_REAL: keywords (real, community) name the box.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, count something else and add a tally row.
teacher_notes: Lesson 2 worksheet. Watch for estimate-instead-of-count at scale.
